items.title: Sonny Williams Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: That's the boy me and him. He started together. ... We came up together. Went to school together. ... Eddie, he started with us on trombone

ctx.x: That's my... That's the boy me and him. He started together. Mm-hmm. I was playing guitar. Yeah, I know him. We came up together. Went to school together. Well, they all did. Eddie died. Freddy died. And the other boy died. So they all did now. Freddy, which is Freddy? Freddy, that's Eddie's brother. Yeah.
